| Status | Listings |
|---|---|
| **Registered** | <citation-number id="query_8a89b4ca" column="listing_count">13,240</citation-number> |
| **Exempt** | <citation-number id="query_8a89b4ca" column="listing_count">1,348</citation-number> |
| **No Regional Entry** | <citation-number id="query_8a89b4ca" column="listing_count">166</citation-number> |
| **No Data** | <citation-number id="query_8a89b4ca" column="listing_count">147</citation-number> |

- **Registered** dominates at ~88% of all listings — these have an actual Mallorca regional registration number (e.g. AT/, AG/, TI/, H/ prefixes).
- **Exempt** (~9%) — listings that reference the Mallorca regional entry but are marked as exempt (e.g. seasonal rentals, hotels).
- **No Regional Entry** (~1.1%) — listings that have a license field but with no Mallorca-specific registration at all (e.g. only a Spain national number).
- **No Data** (~1%) — listings with a completely null license field.

args.sql_query:
SELECT CASE WHEN license IS NULL THEN 'No Data' WHEN license NOT LIKE '%Mallorca - Regional registration number%' THEN 'No Regional Entry' WHEN license LIKE '%Mallorca - Regional registration number%Exempt%' OR license LIKE '%Mallorca - Regional registration number%
Exempt%' THEN 'Exempt' ELSE 'Registered' END AS tourist_license_status, COUNT(*) AS listing_count FROM listings GROUP BY tourist_license_status ORDER BY listing_count DESC;
args.name: Listings by tourist license status (Mallorca regional)

args.title: Listings by Tourist License Status (Mallorca Regional Registration)

suggestions: What are the most common Mallorca registration number prefixes (AT, AG, TI, H...) and how many listings does each have?
Can you break down the exempt listings by exemption type (seasonal rental, hotel, etc.)?
How does the tourist license status distribution vary by neighbourhood or room type?

details.reference_sql:
WITH s AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN license IS NULL THEN 'no_data' WHEN position('Mallorca - Regional registration number' in license) = 0 THEN 'no_regional_entry' WHEN substring(license from 'Mallorca - Regional registration number
([^<]*)') ILIKE 'exempt%' THEN 'exempt' ELSE 'registered' END AS st FROM listings ) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE st = 'registered') AS registered, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE st = 'exempt') AS exempt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE st = 'no_regional_entry') AS no_regional_entry, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE st = 'no_data') AS no_data FROM s
